articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: The GENIUS Act’s guarantees don’t cover DeFi lending
articles.snippet: Institutions weighing DeFi lending tend to ask which markets are safest. Mike Hathaway and Joseph Quintilian of Ajna argue the better question is who can change a loan’s terms after the money is lent, and why a fully backed stablecoin offers no protection against a token vote or a faulty price feed.

articles.title: OKXICE to debut tokenized stock trading with Strategy, Coinbase, Circle this month
articles.snippet: After initial issuer pushback, the blockchain venue is set to start trading on Nov. 23 and said will list over 70 assets, including Strategy’s common and preferred shares and 59 of Direxion's ETFs.

articles.title: Meet Spiko, the largest tokenized fund in the world you’ve probably never heard about
articles.snippet: The firm’s flagship Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund (SAFO) held $2.39 billion in assets under management as of late last month.

articles.title: Bitcoin barely flinches at hot CPI as ETF selling slows
Bitcoin sits out stock rebound as ETF outflows extend to fourth day
articles.snippet: Bitcoin held steady near $74,000 as Tuesday's hot inflation figure lifted the odds on a U.S. interest-rate increase to around 90%. ETF outflows extended to a fourth day and liquidations jumped.
